QuestInfo.name: [Daily] Espionage - Seizing Communication
QuestInfo.0: #b#p3001106##k is looking for someone to handle a commission.
QuestInfo.1:
#p3001106# gives you an espionage commission from #p3001100#. #p3001100# wants you to eliminate Specter soldiers and obtain #b60 #t4033562##k items to gauge the enemy's condition.

#t4033562# items can be obtained from #rSpecter Tamers, Specter Engineers, Specter Miners, Power Specters, Specter Shieldbearers, Warrior Specters, Reaper Specters, and Magician Specters#k, which can be found all over the Heliseum region.

yes.0: Don't forget, only #rSpecter Corps soldiers#k carry those orders.
